title: Implement specodelic compile: Set^K -> TOML / TLA+ / proptest functor
description: Per specs/compile.md. Translate a linted-and-covered spec file's Constraints table into a TOML document, its Model section into a TLA+ (or Alloy) module, and its Properties table into proptest! blocks — without dropping or altering any id. Constraints: compile_is_total, compile_preserves_ids, no_semantic_drift, precondition_satisfied (only linted+covered files). Unblocks model_check, verify, orchestrate.

title: Implement specodelic merge: id collisions + dangling renames pre-merge
description: Per specs/merge.md. Detect what textual git merge can't see: id collisions between branches and renames left dangling by references minted elsewhere. Operates on the derived graph, reuses it rather than re-deriving (graph_reused_not_rederived). Open question: what 'human approved a flagged merge' means operationally.

title: Implement specodelic orchestrate: lint->compile->model_check->verify driver
description: Per specs/orchestrate.md. Drive the six Checker Ownership checkers in dependency order (skip dependents on failure, run independent branches regardless), then coverage, compile, model_check, verify in sequence — gating each transition on the exact specified guards, never looser or stricter. external_completeness runs when a checklist exists but never gates. rename stays out of scope. Depends on compile, model_check, verify. Open question: whether orchestrator owns draft->parsed too.

title: Implement specodelic rename: atomic id rename with link rewrite
description: Per specs/rename.md. Single (old_id, new_id) request: update the defining row and every referencing [[link]] atomically, or leave the repo unchanged. Ends in a verify step re-running linter.referential_integrity and linter.graph_shape. Open question from spec: batch/namespace rename atomicity is Needs-Human-Review. Graph (ddl graph) is done — build on it.

title: Implement specodelic verify: execute proptest blocks + gate
description: Per specs/verify.md. Run every proptest! block compile produced to completion; transition a file to verified only when all pass AND model_check's most recent run against the current compiled artifact is clean. Depends on compile + model_check.

title: Implement specodelic model-check: TLC/Alloy against compiled module
description: Per specs/model_check.md. Run a model checker (TLC or Alloy) against compile's TLA+ output; report no_counterexample-within-bound or a minimal counterexample trace naming the violated invariant. Distinguish model_checked (run happened) from no_counterexample (CLAR-003). Depends on compile.

title: Corpus coverage gaps: 23 constraints lack deriving properties (lint run 2026-09-28)
description: ddl lint specs reports 23 coverage violations: specodelic.md (14: append_only_variants, constraint_kind_closed, coverage, ears_statement, every_state_used, frontmatter_valid, guard_required, law_requires_cases, model_present, no_counterexample, one_capability_per_row, properties_pass, property_kind_closed, prose_untouched), plus merge, rename, refactor, orchestrate, linter.coverage, linter.external_completeness, linter.frontmatter (has_statement), linter.schema_shape (no_prose_field_parsed). Either add deriving Properties rows or narrow the coverage invariant.

title: Scaffold ddl CLI: lint/compile/verify/graph/rename/orchestrate commands on genesis-vibes
Evaluate espectacular scenario-conformance over openspec specs
description: Suite pattern (espectacular/src/openspec.rs): discover '#### Scenario:' blocks under openspec/specs and enforce spec-test correspondence. Once ddl's pipeline commands exist, evaluate wiring espectacular's scenario checks so openspec specs for ddl are verified against tests. Exploratory — decide before implementing orchestrate.

title: Implement specodelic refactor: tidy-first split advisor
description: Per specs/refactor.md. Flag nodes with high unrelated fan-in in the graph as split candidates. Always non-gating (kind==effect, excluded from guards by the format's typing). Open question from spec: should 'unrelated' key off id namespace or directory placement.
